title: Form studio
idea: Form studio: A real form preview sits beside field configuration, validation and recipient/data-retention context.
audience: People who need to build form within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Creators must understand both respondent experience and collected data.
avoidWhen: A designer panel hides privacy or validation behavior.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its build form priority and explicit commitment contract: Publishing requires valid field rules and an explicit data destination.
navigation: Form studio keeps the current build form context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A real form preview sits beside field configuration, validation and recipient/data-retention context.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to build form; creators must understand both respondent experience and collected data.
composition.priority: Publishing requires valid field rules and an explicit data destination.

imagery.role: Support the actual build form context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Edit one field at a time while preserving a usable respondent preview.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the form studio structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no build form content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Publishing requires valid field rules and an explicit data destination.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized build form content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Publishing requires valid field rules and an explicit data destination.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active build form context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
